author: More Perfect Union
description:
Worldwide protests led by Gen-Z have sprung up around the world.

Young people face a future overshadowed by economic instability, limited job options, and climate change. Decades of neoliberalism have led to the decay of public schools, job prospects, and public goods and services as a whole. While the far right has moved to use this calamity to their advantage, young people are rising up globally to reject both fascism and neoliberalism and instead advocate for actual good governance that invests in public goods and invests in their futures.

From France to Brazil to Spain to India to Argentina and Ecuador and beyond, we're seeing an international uprising linked together in the rejection of the far-right and neoliberalism.

Written/hosted/edited: Savannah Fortune
title: HUGE youth-led protests are taking the world by storm

author: More Perfect Union
description:
This election Michigan voters could stop utilities, health insurers and other companies with big government contracts from funding the campaigns of the politicians who regulate them.

Proposal 2 would end the corruption that have led utility bills and health insurance premiums to skyrocket.

We talked to people in Michigan, including @abdulelsayed, about how Michigan could lead the way in reforming our broken campaign finance

Host: @headintheoffice
Producer: Victoria Hammett
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
Editor: Andrew Rivera
title: How one state is taking on corrupt health insurers & utilities
